visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length wavy hair wearing a green button-down shirt stands in a brightly lit kitchen, holding a white snowflake-shaped cake. In the background, two small pistachio-topped tarts sit on a wooden board. (2) The man takes a bite of a slice of the white cake from a plate, expressing an exaggerated look of pleasure with wide eyes. (3) A close-up shows the man holding a carton of Candia French Gourmet Cream next to a glass bowl where white cream is being whisked by an electric mixer. (4) The camera focuses on the white cream being poured from the carton and then the whipped cream forming stiff peaks on the mixer's whisk. (5) The man holds a small pistachio-topped tart, looks at the camera, and then takes a large bite. A close-up follows, showing the inside of the tart with a creamy filling as he breaks it apart. (6) The man holds the cream carton again while showing his smartphone screen, which displays a map and a list of dessert shops. (7) A screen recording shows scrolling through various colorful cakes like mango mille-feuille and rainbow cake. (8) The man concludes by packing two cake boxes, one white and one brown, on the kitchen counter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, cheerful synth music begins as a man's energetic voice enthusiastically introduces a dessert recommendation. (2) A crisp crunching sound effect marks the bite into a cake, accompanied by a cartoonish 'pop' SFX and a playful vocal reaction. (3) The narration shifts to a more informative but still high-energy tone, explaining the technical benefits of the cream as a whirring mixer sound is heard. (4) A 'ding' UI sound effect plays as text overlays appear quickly in sync with the speaker's emphasis on '40% fat content'. (5) Another percussive crunch sound occurs when the speaker bites into a tart, followed by a slight swell in the background music's volume. (6) The video concludes with a rapid sequence of 'whoosh' sounds for scene transitions while the speaker gives a final call to action for Mother's Day.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Sensory Evidence -> Technical Explanation -> Benefit/Stability Demo -> Wider Application -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for Candia French Gourmet Cream. It uses a high-energy review format to showcase the cream's high fat content and superior whipping stability through the lens of a Mother's Day dessert recommendation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Holding the product package, directly naming the brand, and detailing product specifications as selling points.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A well-produced, high-density social media advertisement that effectively blends food review tropes with direct product marketing.
